briefdescription.para: Unit tests for themis::wire V1 protocol types, constants, and compile-time properties defined in include/themis/network/wire_protocol_server.hpp.

detaileddescription.para: These tests mirror the style of test_wire_protocol_v2.cpp. They exercise the header-level types (structs, enums, constants) and the MessageDispatcher without requiring a live TCP connection or protobuf.
